legend: Diego is out with 3$$$3$$$ of his friends (Jorge, Juan and Bob), when out of nowhere one of them realizes that there is a gigantic bar or chocolate, every single one of them is greedy so they want to eat as much chocolate as possible.

After many hours of arguing who gets to eat the most chocolate they came up with the following: the best division is one such that the difference between the person who eats the most chocolate and the person who eats the least chocolate is as small as possible.

As they are about to begin distributing the chocolate bar they came up to a realization, this bar has the shape of a rectangle, has exactly length L$$$L$$$ and also has exactly N−1$$$N-1$$$ different cutting spots, each spot located at a specific position xi$$$x_i$$$ (assuming that the chocolate bar begins in position 0$$$0$$$). So they must cut the chocolate bar in exactly 3$$$3$$$ of the cutting spots.
Help Diego find out the optimal way of dividing the chocolate bar in 4$$$4$$$ such that the difference between whoever eats less and whoever eats most is minimal.
input: A line with 2 integers, N,L$$$N, L$$$ (4≤N≤105,4≤L≤1015)$$$(4 \le N \le 10^5, 4 \le L \le 10^{15})$$$, the amount of cutting spots within the chocolate bar and the length of the chocolate bar.

Followed by a line with N−1$$$N-1$$$ integers in increasing order, representing the position of the ith cutting spot (1≤xi<1015)$$$(1 \le x_i  \lt  10^{15})$$$. It's guaranteed that xi<xi+1$$$x_i  \lt  x_{i+1}$$$ for 1≤i<N−1$$$1 \le i  \lt  N - 1$$$.
output: A single integer M$$$M$$$, the minimal delta between the smallest and biggest piece of chocolate if we divide the bar into exactly 4$$$4$$$ pieces.
note: In the test case, given the positions it's the equivalent of saying that we have 8 pieces of the following lengths: 3 1 1 3 2 2 3 3 There are 2 optimal answers, we can either split it in such a way that the 4 chocolate pieces the friends are going to eat are of sizes 5 5 5 3, or of sizes 4 4 4 6.

legend.ai: Diego 和他的 3$$$3$$$ 位朋友(Jorge、Juan 和 Bob)一起外出时，其中一人突然发现了一块巨大的巧克力棒。他们每个人都很贪心，因此都想尽可能多地吃巧克力。
经过数小时的争论，他们最终得出如下结论：最好的分配方式是，使吃巧克力最多的人与吃得最少的人之间的差值尽可能小。
正当他们准备开始分配巧克力棒时，他们意识到这块巧克力棒呈矩形，长度恰好为 L$$$L$$$，并且有恰好 N−1$$$N-1$$$ 个不同的切割位置，每个位置都对应一个确定的位置 xi$$$x_i$$$(假设巧克力棒从位置 0$$$0$$$ 开始)。因此，他们必须恰好在 3$$$3$$$ 个切割位置处切割巧克力棒。
请帮助 Diego 找出将巧克力棒分成 4$$$4$$$ 份的最优方式，使吃得最少的人与吃得最多的人之间的差值最小。

input.ai: 一行包含 2 个整数 N,L$$$N, L$$$(4≤N≤105,4≤L≤1015)$$$(4 \le N \le 10^5, 4 \le L \le 10^{15})$$$，分别表示巧克力棒上的切割位置数量和巧克力棒的长度。
接下来一行包含 N−1$$$N-1$$$ 个按递增顺序排列的整数，表示第 i 个切割位置的位置(1≤xi<1015)$$$(1 \le x_i  \lt  10^{15})$$$。保证对于 1≤i<N−1$$$1 \le i  \lt  N - 1$$$，都有 xi<xi+1$$$x_i  \lt  x_{i+1}$$$。

output.ai: 单个整数 M$$$M$$$，表示如果我们把巧克力棒恰好分成 4$$$4$$$ 块，最小块与最大块之间的最小差值。

note.ai: 在测试用例中，给定这些位置，等价于说我们有 8 块巧克力，长度分别为：3 1 1 3 2 2 3 3。有两个最优答案：我们可以将其分割成朋友们将要吃掉的 4 块巧克力大小分别为 5 5 5 3，或者分别为 4 4 4 6。
